The '''AR5G Cargo Winch''' was manufactured by [[Utilitech/Legends|Utilitech]]. Designed to be fitted on [[Droid/Legends|droids]], the AR5G had fifty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] cable and was capable of lifting eighty [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].<ref name="CFTD" />
